title: Council spend statement with grouped dates, directorates and suppliers
row_rules: One row per transaction. A blank Payment date, Directorate or Supplier cell repeats the value above it, within the same date group. Negative amounts are refunds and stay negative.
why: The payment date is printed once per date group, the directorate once per run within a date, and the supplier once per run within a directorate, so most rows show only some of their values. Two Dunmore rows are identical apart from the transaction number. Long supplier names wrap onto a second line.
